scope: 16 camctl integration directories; root pytest; four root Node test files
notes: Directory wall sums and full-run elapsed are different: the latter includes export and inter-stage overhead.
Sources/tests/protocol were unchanged during collection; intervening commits contain report data/documentation only.
Effective results use a four-case correction for observer environment interference; first-pass time and results are retained as first-pass records.
Per-command elapsed seconds use monotonic clocks; UTC spans are retained separately and do not replace those timings.
